metrics.name: brandedge_admin_claim_failures
metrics.description: Count of failed admin claim repair/bootstrap/sync operations.

metrics.name: brandedge_subscription_plan_failures
metrics.description: Count of failed subscription plan backend operations.

metrics.name: brandedge_entitlement_command_failures
metrics.description: Count of failed subscriber entitlement commands.

metrics.name: brandedge_invite_accept_failures
metrics.description: Count of failed invite acceptance attempts.

metrics.name: brandedge_survey_submission_rejections
metrics.description: Count of rejected public survey submissions.

metrics.name: brandedge_survey_submission_flags
metrics.description: Count of accepted but suspicious public survey submissions.

metrics.name: brandedge_identity_migration_conflicts
metrics.description: Count of legacy identity migration conflicts requiring manual review.

alerts.name: brandedge-admin-claim-failures
alerts.documentation: Admin claim repair/bootstrap has failed repeatedly. Check canonical users/{uid} records, Cloud Functions deployment, and custom claim writes.

alerts.name: brandedge-subscription-plan-failures
alerts.documentation: Subscription plan management backend is failing. Check callable deployment, permissions, and plan validation paths.

alerts.name: brandedge-entitlement-command-failures
alerts.documentation: Subscriber entitlement commands are failing. Check admin claims, callable health, and validation conflicts.

alerts.name: brandedge-invite-accept-failures
alerts.documentation: Invite acceptance is failing repeatedly. Check invite expiry, auth email matching, and claims sync.

alerts.name: brandedge-survey-rejections-spike
alerts.documentation: Public survey rejection volume spiked. Review App Check, cooldown rules, and abuse patterns.

alerts.name: brandedge-survey-flagged-spike
alerts.documentation: Suspicious survey submissions increased. Review flagged response patterns and abuse controls.

alerts.name: brandedge-identity-migration-conflicts
alerts.documentation: A legacy user migration hit a conflict. Review duplicate email or UID mismatch cases in Admin Users.
